summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting transactions under an ongoing share repurchase program initiated on December 15, 2025. The filing covers trades from April 27 to May 22, 2026, with a detailed table for April 27–30 showing 184,680 shares repurchased at weighted average prices between €57.31 and €58.53 per share, totaling €242.9 million since program inception. The program is an open-market buyback executed on US trading venues, returning capital to shareholders without a fixed expiration date. Watch for continued execution pace and impact on liquidity and EPS.
